digest.component_or_area: test framework, CI/CD workflow, ruff linting
propositions: 27 defects in recent review were tests that could not fail or burned CI time due to absent subprocess return-code checks and missing timeout controls
The codebase has 336 PLW1510 findings (subprocess calls without explicit check= policy) and 1811 PT findings across src, tests, and scripts, of which only 481 are targeted for adoption
Local pytest execution lacks per-test timeout budget; only CI workflows enforce --timeout=300 or --timeout-method=thread, creating a gap between local and CI behavior
Unit-tier tests measured under --timeout=20 --timeout-method=thread showed zero timeout failures on 5097 passed tests, indicating the 20s budget is viable for that tier
The current ruff configuration does not select PLW1510 or any PT codes, and make lint does not reach the two hygiene check scripts (check_wall_clock_asserts.py, check_raw_git_writes.py)

Adopting the subset of ruff codes (11 specific PT codes plus PLW1510) and adding pytest timeout configuration to pyproject.toml will enforce test hygiene locally, align CI and local execution, and require explicit justification for slow tests via @pytest.mark.timeout() decorators
